pr_title: Add option to play subtags & repetitions when exporting animations
pr_body:
This PR fixes #4173 and also includes a commit with a fix for the "ping-pong reverse" direction when exporting animations.

The main changes are around a new FramesSequence class that is similar to SelectedFrames but allows us to keep ranges of frames in any direction (increasing or decreasing) in the same order as the frames were added.
pr_comments: One thing that might worth considering is the fact that FramesSequence and SelectedFrames have several methods that behaves exactly the same way, so I think we could take this changes a step further and make SelectedFrames a subclass of FramesSequence without much hassle. Just let me know what do you think.
Let me know if you prefer all the commits squashed but 2ec2896471307f9c8b1e7355a6695a253c6ac92a

I'm starting to test this change (didn't review it yet). There is no problem about the multiple commits 👍  

I've just tested this file: [tags4.aseprite.zip](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/files/13788249/tags4.aseprite.zip)

And the output doesn't include the last tag in reverse modes 4 times (it should show 10-9-8 four times):

![tags4](https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/assets/39654/c5a3353a-7b4d-4b12-b5aa-998b5b9d6880)

But it shows only 10 at the end, you can compare with the regular editor playback.
Just fixed, it was an issue in the Playback class when using PlayAll mode. https://github.com/aseprite/aseprite/pull/4211/commits/0598e90ce0fd5c09b104e05d0b8993ba6ef55998 fixes it.
I've introduced all the suggested changes along some additional fixes
Just merged 👍  I'll create another issue with some future work/fixes to do.
Oh, I didn't pushed any changes about the "frames" namespace we were talking. I was working on another thing. I'm going to introduce the changes in a new PR.

issue_context.title: Add option to follow tags repeat field in GIF export
issue_context.body: Related to #1252, we should be able to select which tags, in which order, n times to repeat/follow repeat counter, etc. when we export a GIF file: https://twitter.com/2dchaos/status/1557113836183896065
comments: @martincapello in case that you take this one, as a first version we can just have a checkbox to "follow tags" (probably with an extra option to know what to do with the infinite loops, if one loop or repeat a large number of times); instead of a complex UI to specify a detailed list of tags to export

review_comments: Add a comment that this class is based in `SelectedFrames` and a `TODO` to for future work to be done to remove all the duplicated code in some way. A similar comment can go to the `SelectedFrames` class definition.
